claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2025, Serve's fleet consisted of over 2,000 sidewalk delivery robots.
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025, Serve's fleet consisted of over 2,000 sidewalk delivery robots.

claims.claim_text: Serve maintains platform-level integrations with food delivery platforms, such as Uber Eats and DoorDash, that enable real-time order dispatch and operational coordination.
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.object_value: Uber Eats and DoorDash platform integrations
claims.source_quote: We maintain platform-level integrations with food delivery platforms, such as Uber Eats and DoorDash, that enable our robots to transmit real-time presence and status information and to receive delivery requests associated with customer orders placed on those platforms.

claims.claim_text: For FY2025, Customer A represented 37% and Customer B represented 18% of total revenues; combined ~55% from two unnamed customers (likely Uber Eats and DoorDash).
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.object_value: Customer A 37%, Customer B 18% of FY2025 revenue
claims.source_quote: Customer A sales as a percentage of total revenues 37 % 26 % Customer B sales as a percentage of total revenues 18 % 65 %

claims.claim_text: Serve generated $2.7 million in revenue for FY2025 (vs $1.8M in FY2024) against a net loss of $101.4 million and accumulated deficit of $208.9 million.
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.object_value: $2.65M FY25 revenue, $101.4M net loss, $208.9M accumulated deficit
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we generated revenues of $2.7 million and $1.8 million, respectively, and reported net loss of $101.4 million and $39.2 million, respectively. ... accumulated deficit of $208.9 million.

claims.claim_text: Management concluded disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting were not effective as of Dec 31, 2025 due to multiple material weaknesses (segregation of duties, control environment, comprehensive accounts and disclosures).
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.object_value: ICFR not effective at FY2025 year-end with multiple material weaknesses
claims.source_quote: our principal executive officer and principal financial officer concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective because of the material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting described below. ... The Company did not design and maintain effective controls to verify appropriate segregation of duties. The Company did not design and maintain effective controls related to substantially all accounts and disclosures.

claims.claim_text: On January 27, 2026 Serve completed the acquisition of Diligent Robotics Inc. (Moxi healthcare robots) for ~$29M, extending the platform to hospitals and citing 'established commercial relationships with healthcare systems and institutions.'
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.object_value: Diligent Robotics acquired ~$29M, Jan 27 2026; healthcare hospital robots
claims.source_quote: On January 27, 2026, the Company completed its acquisition of Diligent Robotics, Inc. ... aggregated value of $29.0 million ... We expect to leverage Diligent's technology alongside our existing platform to enhance product capabilities, accelerate deployment opportunities, and support scalable, recurring revenue growth through Diligent's established commercial relationships with healthcare systems and institutions.

claims.claim_text: Company raised $80M in January 2025 registered direct offering at $19/share and another $100M in October 2025 at $16/share (Nvidia-led financing per cohort metadata).
claims.subject: Serve Robotics
claims.source_quote: On January 7, 2025, the Company entered into a securities purchase agreement ... aggregate of 4,210,525 shares ... at a price of $19.00 per share. The gross proceeds ... approximately $80.0 million ... On October 10, 2025 ... 6,250,000 shares ... at a price of $16.00 per share. The gross proceeds ... approximately $100.0 million
